response.sql: WITH tallies AS (SELECT archstat AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), shares AS (SELECT status, tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share FROM tallies) SELECT status, tally, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share FROM shares WHERE share > average_share

assumptions.assumption: A project is counted once per archival status, even if it has multiple QC records with that status. A project with records under different statuses is counted in each.

alternatives.interpretation: Tally QC records associated with projects, counting repeated records for the same project.
alternatives.sql: WITH tallies AS (SELECT archstat AS status, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), shares AS (SELECT status, tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share FROM tallies) SELECT status, tally, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share FROM shares WHERE share > average_share
